sharedPrompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity 1280x720 desktop game UI mockup. Preserve the current game room, top-left location text, top-right local clock, bottom-left circular Nosh portrait badge, centered five-slot inventory bar, Journal and Menu buttons, proportions, pixel-painted detail, and textured olive-charcoal void. Change only the far-right navigation concept. Use a realistic shippable code-native interface treatment in warm walnut, dark olive, muted sage, fine brass, and cream text. Keep all existing layout and artwork unchanged outside the far-right navigation area. Use only these exact map labels if visible: OFFICE MAP, BEDROOM, KITCHEN, YOU ARE HERE. No new character, logo, watermark, or unrelated controls.

concepts.prompt: An always-visible circular floor-plan medallion on the far right, exactly balancing the player's circular avatar badge on the far left. Inside the brass ring, show a very clean two-room schematic with BEDROOM and KITCHEN as clickable-looking areas, a small warm current-location dot, and a restrained OFFICE MAP caption below. Prioritize symmetry, instant glanceability, and minimal visual weight.

A slim vertical brass-framed room directory on the far right, occupying the same visual weight and footprint as the player's avatar badge but using a rectangular parchment-and-olive floor-plan card. Show BEDROOM and KITCHEN as two clearly separated stacked destinations with a subtle connecting line; highlight the current room with a small YOU ARE HERE marker. Prioritize label clarity and room to scale to more destinations.

A small circular compass/map badge on the far-right edge with a tasteful expanded map drawer open toward the left above the inventory bar. The badge visually balances the player's avatar while the drawer shows a compact two-room floor plan with BEDROOM, KITCHEN, and a YOU ARE HERE marker. The expanded drawer should feel intentional and unobtrusive, demonstrating the open interaction state. Prioritize keeping the default shell light while allowing richer navigation on demand.

Use 03-expandable-drawer.png as the exact layout target and 02-vertical-directory.png as the paper-material reference. Keep the small circular brass compass as the only closed-state map control. Show its clicked state with a compact physical paper office map opening up and left from the compass. Use warm cream parchment, fine brass edging, subtle walnut backing, clear BEDROOM and KITCHEN targets, a restrained brass pin, YOU ARE HERE, and a subtle doorway connection. Preserve the room, portrait, inventory, Journal/Menu, clock, location heading, compass, spacing, and every other UI element. Change only the expanded map treatment; add no unrelated controls, text, logos, characters, or watermark.
